zones.name: Classroom / Endpoints
standing_authority: Mission Technicians within approved mission scope

zones.name: Rack 1 / Mission Control
zones.mission_authority: Mission Technicians may administer specifically designated instructional equipment only.

zones.name: Rack 2 / Production SOTE
zones.mission_authority: Mission Technicians may consume authorized services; infrastructure administration requires explicit mission authorization.

zones.name: Rack 3 / Restricted Cyber Range
zones.mission_authority: SOTE Operators require specific authorization and supervision for infrastructure work. Mission Technicians may receive bounded target/service access without infrastructure authority.

racks.name: Rack 1 / Mission Control
racks.purpose: Instructional networking access plus the protected aggregation pathway connecting classroom systems to SOTE.
racks.authority: SOTE Operations and Mission Command for core infrastructure; Mission Technicians only on designated instructional devices.
racks.current_priority: Recommission and validate aggregation switching and the classroom-to-Rack-2 pathway.

racks.name: Rack 2 / Production SOTE
racks.purpose: Production SOTE infrastructure and service hosting.
racks.current_priority: Establish production switching, DHCP/DNS, and classroom-reachable GLPI after the Rack 1 path is validated.

racks.name: Rack 3 / Restricted Cyber Range
racks.purpose: Controlled cybersecurity infrastructure and intentionally hostile instructional targets isolated from production.
racks.authority: Mission Command standing authority. Operator infrastructure access requires specific authorization and supervision.
racks.current_priority: Document and build the cyber-range control plane while preserving strict separation from production SOTE.
